hed: Wednesday on the Lake: Mild skies, holiday lights, and steady fishing
deck: Wednesday, November 18 — a classic midweek Branson day with highs near 66°F, mostly cloudy skies, no rain, and calm winds. Table Rock Lake remains fishable with stable levels; holiday shows are in full swing and the Landing fountain dances on schedule.
